measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Pawtucket to borrow up to $2 million through bonds and notes for the fiscal 2028 and 2029 capital-improvement program. The money could fund design, construction, reconstruction, repair and equipment for streets, sidewalks and other transportation infrastructure, including drainage and landscaping.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $2 million in borrowing for those transportation projects in fiscal 2028 and 2029.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Pawtucket to borrow up to $4 million through bonds and notes for the fiscal 2028 and 2029 capital-improvement program. Eligible work includes planning, evaluation, design, construction, equipment and reconstruction of sanitary and storm sewers.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $4 million in borrowing for those sewer projects in fiscal 2028 and 2029.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed sewer-project borrowing authority.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Pawtucket to borrow up to $2.5 million through bonds and notes to improve and replace road-safety infrastructure and traffic-control devices for the fiscal 2028 and 2029 capital-improvement program.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $2.5 million in borrowing for those road-safety and traffic-control projects.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Pawtucket to borrow up to $5 million through bonds and notes for the fiscal 2028 and 2029 capital-improvement program. The money could fund construction, renovation, improvement, repair, alterations, furnishings and equipment for public buildings.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $5 million in borrowing for those public-building projects in fiscal 2028 and 2029.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed public-building borrowing authority.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Pawtucket to borrow up to $2 million through bonds and notes for bridge construction, reconstruction, repair, equipment and related costs in the fiscal 2028 and 2029 capital-improvement program.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $2 million in borrowing for those bridge projects and related costs.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed bridge borrowing authority.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Pawtucket to borrow up to $3 million through bonds and notes to repave city streets for the fiscal 2028 and 2029 capital-improvement program.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $3 million in borrowing for that street repaving.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed street-repaving borrowing authority.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Pawtucket to borrow up to $2 million through bonds and notes for the fiscal 2028 and 2029 capital-improvement program. The money could fund renovation, construction, reconstruction and equipment for public recreation facilities, including buying land.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $2 million in borrowing for those recreation facilities and land purchases.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed recreation-project borrowing authority.
